text.p: - The board of directors of the PTT, the Swiss postal and telephone service, forecast a 1997 profit of 150 million Swiss francs.

- Cement group Holderbank's after-tax profit fell to 283 million Swiss francs in the first half of the year, compared to 306 million in the first six months of 1995. Nevertheless, the company said it improved its strategic position with large investments.
- Sihl Group, a paper company, posted an 11 percent drop in net sales to 209.6 million Swiss francs in the first six months of 1996.
- The Swiss government is seeking approval for another 645 million franc credit towards further preparation of NEAT, the trans-Alpine tunnel.
- The merger of pharmaceutical giants Ciba-Geigy and Sandoz into Novartis may not officially take place until next year, depending on the Federal Trade Commission review in the U.S. JOURNAL DE GENEVE
- Stellram, a subsidiary of the U.S. firm Teledyne is cutting 67 jobs and laying off 49 employees.
